Install Java 8 and make sure that you use the correct version to open that file.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Fira said:
I was actually trying to open java files that are not rpg maker.
Click to expand...
all java files are not of the RPG Makers, because MV and MZ use javascript.
java is to javascript like ham is to hamster - they share the first few letters but have absolutely nothing to do with each other
so no one here can help you with java unless they learned it somewhere else, you would be better helped by going with those questions to a java community.
or to remove java and install a javascript editor if that was what you wanted.
